title: Emergent Behavior and Uncertainty in IoT-Enhanced Business Processes: Challenges and Future Directions
abstract: arXiv:2608.28919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: IoT-enhanced business processes are characterized by high complexity due to heterogeneous actors, varying levels of autonomy among participating systems, continuously evolving execution contexts spanning the digital and physical worlds, and continuous event streams. In such settings, process behavior partially emerges only at runtime through complex interactions involving humans, IoT devices, physical objects, software systems, agents, and services. This complexity introduces partial observability, uncertainty, and runtime dynamics that are difficult to anticipate and that challenge traditional business process management (BPM) assumptions and systems. We discuss these challenges from three perspectives, addressing 1) uncertainty representation, 2) operationalization of IoT-enhanced processes, and 3) runtime management of emergent behavior. translated_title: 物联网增强业务流程中的涌现行为与不确定性：挑战与未来方向
translated_abstract: 物联网增强的业务流程具有高度复杂性，其特征包括异构的参与者、参与系统之间各异的自治程度、跨越数字世界与物理世界的持续演化的执行环境，以及连续不断的事件流。在此类环境中，流程行为仅在运行时通过人类、物联网设备、物理对象、软件系统、智能体与服务之间复杂的交互而部分涌现。这种复杂性带来了部分可观测性、不确定性以及难以预料的运行时动态，对传统业务流程管理（BPM）的假设和系统构成了挑战。我们从三个视角讨论这些挑战：1）不确定性的表示，2）物联网增强流程的可操作化，3）涌现行为的运行时管理。基于一个激励性场景和对现有研究现状的分析，我们识别出尚待解决的开放研究问题（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文从不确定性表示、物联网增强流程的可操作化以及涌现行为的运行时管理三个视角，系统分析了物联网增强业务流程中因多主体复杂交互而产生的涌现行为与不确定性对传统业务流程管理的挑战，并指出了未来的开放研究方向。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes, from three perspectives—uncertainty representation, operationalization of IoT-enhanced processes, and runtime management of emergent behavior—how emergent behavior and uncertainty arising from complex multi-actor interactions in IoT-enhanced business processes challenge traditional BPM, and identifies open research directions.
